# Security Policy

Security is a top priority at OcteDigital. We take vulnerabilities seriously and appreciate the efforts of security researchers and the community in helping us keep our systems and data safe.

## Supported Versions

We support the current major release and the immediately preceding major release with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in any OcteDigital repository or service, **do not open a public issue.**

Instead, please report it privately via email to our security team: `hello@octedigital.com`.

### What to include in your report:

- A description of the vulnerability.
- The repositories, services, or URLs affected.
- Detailed steps to reproduce the issue.
- Any potential impact you have identified.

### What to expect:

- We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report within 48 hours.
- We will send you regular updates about our progress.
- If your report is validated, we will work quickly to develop and deploy a fix.
- We will notify you when the issue has been resolved.
